_source.chapter: บทที่ 5 — การประมาณราคาในงานซ่อมบำรุงปกติ (Ch.5 Cost estimation for routine maintenance)
_source.file: ค่มือทางหลวง_onweb.pdf
_source.note: Per-unit costs are the manual's own worked-example results (total activity cost / quantity). They already include labour + materials + machinery. Because fixed daily crew/machine costs are spread over the batch quantity, these rates assume a normal maintenance batch (as in the manual's examples, ~600-1200 m2). District 'ราคากลาง' may differ; treat these as the reference baseline.

crack_sealing.note: Manual gives no fixed per-unit figure (material depends on crack width/depth). Set a district rate here.

damage_to_repair_mapping._comment: Maps a detected damage class (+ severity) to the repair method used to cost it. PROPOSED — confirm with an engineer/advisor before relying on it.

component_rates._comment: Underlying unit rates from the same manual, kept for transparency / re-computation.

physical_quantities._comment: For deriving physical quantities (volume, mass) from a detection. Repair-layer thickness: patching fills a layer (manual: Skin Patching 'ความหนา 5 ซม.'); seals are thin surface treatments (~0). Density of compacted hot/cold asphalt mix ~2300 kg/m3.
